/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/waqt-sajjad-ne-kaise-wo-gzara-ho-ga.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
header, _, tail = original.partition(b'romanLyrics: ')
_, boundary, source = tail.partition(b'\\n---\\n')
assert boundary and len(source.decode().strip().splitlines()) == 23
roman = \"\"\"Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo
Waqt Sajjad ne kaise (mera bimaar imaam)
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)

1
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)
Naam Zainab ka jo ghairoṅ ne pukaara ho ga
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)

2
Ya Rab koi mil jaaye na pehchaanne waala
(Baazaar meiṅ Sajjad dua maaṅg raha hai)
Lo Husain ibn-e-Ali pyaase zibh hone lage
Kitna sharminda wo darya ka kinaara ho ga
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)

3
Wo gira zeen se Zainab ki rida ka zaamin
Kaun ab Fatema jaayi ka sahaara ho ga
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)

4
Sar-e-maidaan tu jaane to laga hai Asghar
Kis tarah tere bina maaṅ ka guzaara ho ga
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)

5
Nok-e-neza pe bahaane lage aaṅsu Maula
Phir Sakina ko kisi shakhs ne maara ho ga
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)

6
Roz-e-mahshar ka hameiṅ dar nahiṅ koi Shaukat
Haath Shabbir ke qadmoṅ pe hamaara ho ga
(Waqt Sajjad ne kaise wo guzaara ho ga)\"\"\"
roman = roman.replace('zeen', 'zin').replace('aaṅsu', 'aansu')
lines = roman.splitlines()
assert sum(bool(line) and not line.isdigit() for line in lines) == 23
assert [line for line in lines if line.isdigit()] == list('123456')
assert all(ord(char) < 128 or char == 'ṅ' for char in roman)
block = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in lines)
p.write_bytes(header + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + block.encode() + boundary + source)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == source
PY"
